Models & Pricing: deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro off-peak and peak rates; the legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and billed at the Flash price
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash release: new pricing takes effect at 04:00 UTC on September 10, 2026
Change log: V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp retired and their names routed to V4.1 Flash; V4 Pro continues with unchanged billing
List models: deepseek-flash 1,048,576-token context, 393,216 max output tokens, text and image input, effort low/high/max with default high
Vision: deepseek-flash accepts images in user messages
Thinking mode: on by default at effort high, turned off with thinking disabled or effort none; reasoning_content is passed back when the request carries tools
Kimi API pricing (international platform, USD): K3 cache writes by TTL, cache-hit, input and output prices; K2 cache-hit, cache-miss and output prices
Kimi API pricing (China platform, CNY)
Model list: the moonshot-v1 series, including the -vision-preview variants, was discontinued on August 31, 2026; use kimi-k3
Pricing (USD per 1M tokens): GLM-5.3, GLM-5.2 and GLM-5.3-Flash input, cached input and output
BigModel pricing (CNY per 1M tokens): GLM-5.3, GLM-5.2 and GLM-5.3-Flash input, output and cache hit
GLM-5.3-Flash: 1M context, 128K output, video, image, text and file input, thinking always on
Chat completion API: GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash take reasoning_effort low, high or max; tool_choice supports only auto; max_tokens up to 131072
Pay-as-you-go pricing (USD): MiniMax-M2.7 input, output, prompt caching read and write
Pay-as-you-go pricing (China platform, CNY per 1M tokens): MiniMax-M2.7 input, output, cache read and write
Anthropic-compatible API: M2.x models take text and tool blocks only, thinking cannot be disabled, thinking blocks are kept unchanged in later turns
Text generation: MiniMax-M2.7 204,800-token context; international base URLs
Anthropic-compatible prompt caching: cache_control, 5-minute lifetime refreshed on hit
Text generation (China platform): base URLs api.minimax.cn/anthropic and api.minimax.cn/v1
Anthropic-compatible prompt caching (China platform): cached content lives 5 minutes
Messages API: max_tokens up to 204800 for M2.x models
Supported models: GPT-OSS 20B and 120B production models, 131,072-token context, 65,536 max completion tokens, input and output prices
GPT-OSS 120B: input $0.15, cached input $0.075, output $0.60 per 1M tokens
GPT-OSS 20B: input $0.075, cached input $0.037, output $0.30 per 1M tokens
Prompt caching: automatic for GPT-OSS models, 50% discount on cached input tokens
Tool use: GPT-OSS supports tool use but not parallel tool use
Reasoning: GPT-OSS reasoning_effort low, medium, high
Chat completions API: max_completion_tokens, tool_choice none/auto/required, temperature 0-2
Serverless pricing (USD per 1M tokens, input / cached input / output): Kimi K3, OpenAI GPT OSS 120B
Kimi K3: accounts/fireworks/models/kimi-k3, 1,048,576-token context, function calling, image input
GPT OSS 120B: accounts/fireworks/models/gpt-oss-120b, 131k context, function calling, text input
Chat completions API, reasoning_effort: GPT-OSS 120B and 20B accept only low, medium or high, default medium
Chat completions API: max_tokens, tool_choice auto/none/required, temperature 0-2, streaming, system messages
Model Studio model pricing (CNY per 1M tokens): qwen3.8-max in Beijing, Singapore (International scope) and Frankfurt, Virginia and Tokyo (Global scope)
Model Studio model pricing (USD per 1M tokens): qwen3.8-max and qwen3.8-max-0902 in Hong Kong (China), Global scope
Claude Haiku 5.5: claude-haiku-5-5, released October 7, 2026, 1M context, 128K max output, adaptive thinking, default effort medium, text and images in; omit temperature, top_p and top_k
Claude Haiku 5.5: thinking blocks tied to the producing account and an unchanged conversation prefix; forced tool_choice accepted; non-default sampling parameters rejected
Effort levels: low, medium, high, xhigh and max on Claude Haiku 5.5, default medium; thinking disabled accepted at high effort or below
Structured outputs: supported models include claude-haiku-5-5
Claude API standard token prices: Claude Haiku 5.5 priced by prompt length, up to and over 100,000 tokens; Claude Sonnet 5.5 cache hits at 0.05x base input ($0.10 per million tokens)
Release notes, October 7, 2026: Claude Haiku 5.5 launched; Claude Sonnet 5.5 prompt cache reads lowered from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens, all other prices unchanged
